title: Automate Connector Repeatedly Prompts for Re-authentication
alternate_search_terms: Automate connector keeps asking to reauthenticate
Contentstack connector session expired every few hours
Automate workflow interrupted by login prompt

extracted_facts.problem: The customer's Automate workflow using the Contentstack connector kept prompting for re-authentication every few hours, interrupting scheduled automations.
extracted_facts.root_cause: The connected app had been authorized using a personal Contentstack login with short session expiry set by the customer's IT policy.
resolution_steps: Create a dedicated service-account login with standard session settings instead of a personal login.
Reconnect the Automate app using the new service-account login.
